source_description: Synthetic cabin with broad rectangular wall selection
prompt: Change only the wooden cabin walls to muted terracotta red. Keep the roof, windows, door, camera viewpoint, object positions and natural lighting unchanged.
timing_definition: Active time is ComfyUI execution_start through website final PNG save. Total time also includes the shared engine queue wait.
boundary_delta_definition: Mean absolute RGB difference from the original within the painted 3-pixel boundary band. A seam indicator for this fixture, not a general image-quality score.
limitations: One synthetic scene per configuration; these times are not guarantees for other images.
Quick reduces fine detail and changes to the faster 4-bit model in this test.
Alignment was correctly skipped on both real outputs; correction of known translation drift is covered by the synthetic pixel regression test.
Large selections and maximum working resolution can take as long as whole-image edits.
This installed model node does not expose a native latent inpainting mask.
A physical phone was not tested.
